Vision Government Solutions

|

PLAINFIELD,CT

|

Welcome

The Town of Plainfield
contracted with Vision Government Solutions to assist with the 2022 state
mandated revaluation project. Both the
Assessor's Office and Vision Government Solutions would like to thank Plainfield
residents for their patience and cooperation throughout the 2022 Revaluation
project.

Shown on this site are assessments of all taxable
and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2022. The
previous assessments were as of October 1, 2017.

Please
note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied
to the final assessments.

Please do not use the current mill rate to
estimate your taxes. A new mill rate
will be established once the grand list is finalized and the budget completed.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
